subject: general
question: The first train steamed off from Mumbai to ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thane**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Thane** was the destination of the first train that steamed off from Mumbai.
 
• This historic journey took place on **16th April 1853**.
 
• The train covered a distance of **34 kilometers** from Mumbai to Thane.
 
• This event marked the beginning of the railway system in India.
 
• The train was operated by the **Great Indian Peninsula Railway**.
 
• The inaugural journey was attended by a large number of dignitaries and marked a significant milestone in India's transportation history.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The first train in India ran with **14 carriages** and carried about **400 passengers**.
 
• This event laid the foundation for the vast and extensive railway network that India has today.
 
• The introduction of the railway system in India had a profound impact on the country's economy and social structure, facilitating easier and faster movement of goods and people.
 
• Today, Indian Railways is one of the largest railway networks in the world, covering over **67,000 kilometers**.
 
• The railways play a crucial role in the daily commute of millions of people and the transportation of goods across the country.
